propositions: Explicit review-plan on a bug with non-test file_impact must escalate from light advisory tier to full blocking rubric at both precheck and route_criteria seams, and in batch-runner fan-in, keyed on persisted blast-radius state without CLI flags or step-input schema changes.

Gerrit DET criterion must block bug fixes with >150 non-test lines lacking current or code-drifted plan-review attestation, reading cross-host via opcert_from_record + trusted_env_keyring + verify_opcert + compute_validity.

Attestation verdict predicate must accept {certified, stale-code, stale-head}, flag stale/malformed/untrusted verdicts and cross-host op-cert failures {mismatch, key_not_valid_at_era, unknown_kind, unknown_scheme, invalid}, and fail open (advisory only) on {unavailable, error, unknown-future}.
Non-test line classification must exclude tests/** and conftest.py, with the 150-line threshold as a single shared named constant imported by both the criterion and backtest script.
Backtest over 113 historical bug-fix commits must flag exactly the 13 adjudicated-substantive commits and zero mechanical false positives, validating the non-test classification rule and threshold.
